limitations: Only REX.W MOV register,[RIP+disp32] byte encodings loading the one verified IAT slot are searched within .text. This is a follow-up to the completed zero-result FF15/FF25 probe, not a retry of it. Other encodings, thunk chains and runtime-resolved calls may be missed.
Raw matches are candidates until instruction alignment and call semantics are verified. Inline data can match.
No code outside .text, resources, saves or unrelated modules is searched. Full-file hashing is separate from interpretation.
